hook.name: BucketHook
hook.description: A single-pool Uniswap v4 hook for the Bucket Protocol that collects a configurable USDT fee on each swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, depositing fees into an epoch-based escrow. Restricts liquidity additions and removals to a designated LP lock contract, blocks all donations, and gates trading on both a governance bootstrap flag and an epoch start timestamp.
